evidence: Changes Guix release build scripts, toolchain definitions, and ELF checks under contrib/guix/ to produce -static-pie Linux binaries, carrying the Build system label.
rationale: Produces static-pie binaries that expand release portability to non-glibc distributions like Alpine, NixOS, and systems with older glibcs. Release notes and feedback confirm this solves real execution blockers on musl, older distros, and containers, while preserving release reproducibility and security checks.
